description.subtitle: Real Madrid adidas water bottle for training 750 ml - navy blue
description.intro: This official Real Madrid bottle is perfect to accompany you in your workouts, matches or outdoors. Made of resistant material and ergonomic design, it allows you to stay hydrated while representing your club with pride.
key_benefits: Official club design: Light the Royal Madrid shield with pride.
Ligereza y comodidad: Solo 97 gramos para llevarlo a cualquier parte.
Quick and easy use: Sports nozzle for easy drinking.
Durable material: Composition in polyethylene resistant to daily use.
Ideal for workouts: Stay hydrated during physical activity.
